description: This Kotlin source file defines a Fragment called ListFragment used within an Android application to display different lists of items, such as donations, volunteers, projects, donor CRM, reports, and settings. It interacts with a mock API client to fetch data and dynamically updates the UI based on the selected list kind.

classes.name: ListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of items fetched from a mock API, supporting multiple list types via an enum.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, determines the list kind, fetches data from the API, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ListFragment with a specific list kind argument.
